USA.reason: Origin of US export controls on advanced chips and chipmaking tools

NLD.reason: ASML makes all EUV lithography machines; Dutch export licenses since 2023 and expanded to DUV immersion systems in Sept 2024

JPN.reason: Makes chipmaking tools (Tokyo Electron, Nikon, Kokusai); licensing on 23 advanced equipment types since July 2023

TWN.reason: TSMC makes most advanced AI chips; Taiwan began prosecuting chip-server smuggling to China in 2026

DEU.reason: Zeiss is the sole optics supplier for ASML's EUV machines

CHN.reason: Target of US and allied chip controls; supplies about 98-99% of low-purity gallium

SGP.reason: Singapore prosecutors charged men in a US$390 million server fraud case over possible Nvidia chips bound for Malaysia and China

MYS.reason: US-origin AI chips needed a Malaysian trade permit from July 14, 2025 after reports of China-bound transshipment

THA.reason: US prosecutors say about 400 Nvidia A100 GPUs were transshipped to China via Malaysia and Thailand (Nov 2025 case)

HKG.reason: Reported reexport hub for AI chips bound for mainland China; Taiwan cases in 2026 routed servers via Hong Kong and Macau
